description: Defines the List class template and related internal classes and functions for managing lists of IValue objects in PyTorch, including iterators, references, and internal implementation details.

classes.name: ListImpl
classes.description: Internal implementation of a list, managing a vector of IValue and its type.

classes.name: ListElementReference
classes.description: Reference to an element in the List, supporting assignment and conversion.

classes.name: ListIterator
classes.description: Iterator class for List, supporting random access and iterator operations.

classes.name: List
classes.description: Template class representing a list of elements of type T, with copy-on-write semantics and various list operations.

methods.name: List(std::initializer_list<T>)
methods.description: Constructs a List with initial values.

methods.name: List(ArrayRef<T>)
methods.description: Constructs a List from an ArrayRef.

methods.name: List(TypePtr)
methods.description: Creates a generic list with runtime type info (internal use).

methods.name: copy()
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the list.

methods.name: get(size_type) const
methods.description: Returns element at position with bounds checking.

methods.name: extract(size_type) const
methods.description: Removes and returns element at position.

methods.name: set(size_type, T&&)
methods.description: Assigns new value at position with move semantics.

methods.name: is(const List<T>&)
methods.description: Checks if two lists are the same object.

methods.name: vec()
methods.description: Returns a std::vector of list elements.
